name: print-social-playful-sticker-badge-poster-set
title: Colorful Sticker-Badge Ad Poster Set
whatItIs: A trio of vertical brand posters: a central one with a smiling woman in a pink bucket hat on a purple field with a pink starburst, overlapping badge stickers and a bold rounded headline, flanked by cropped sibling layouts on cream.
whatItMeans: Bright saturated color, chunky rounded type and pill-shaped stickers create a friendly, energetic tone that feels youthful and beauty-adjacent. The set shows a coherent system, not a single one-off.
techniques: Cut-out photo layered over a large starburst shape for pop and depth
Scatter wavy-edged and pill-shaped sticker badges at tilted angles
Highlight part of the headline with a solid orange block
Show the same system in different color backgrounds (purple, cream) to prove flexibility
Cropped edges of neighbor cards to imply a larger series
bestFor: Beauty, lifestyle and consumer app campaigns

vocabulary.definition: A rounded or scalloped label placed over a layout as if stuck on.
A multi-pointed shape behind a subject to add energy.
A solid rectangle behind text words to mark emphasis.
